scope: Read-only exhaustive preservation and finite-value checks of completed method event/grid/residual files; no solver, ray trace, or production analyze.py run.

checks: All event IDs and all original event metadata strings equal their initial-event records.
All residual row indices and observation metadata strings equal the corresponding input observation, excluding the observed value replaced by residual.

limitations: This record remains incomplete until all three named methods have complete, verified outputs.
A process already reaped by the parent has no directly available exit status here; the parent pipeline owns exit-status verification.
Provider/native metadata preservation is checked against the prepared authoritative inputs; upstream provider interpretation is documented separately.
Catalog displacement is not location error against truth. Negative geoid depth does not by itself establish a source above local terrain.
Boundary counts are properties of constrained estimates, not evidence of source-depth recovery.
Final-ray stationarity and nonlinear convergence are not established by finite outputs or residual reduction. Automatic final raychecks remain a separate pipeline step.
